[00:29] Researchers Use ChatGPT and Codex to Accelerate the Search for New Antibiotics. Drug-resistant infections (感染；传染病。) pose an urgent threat to global healthcare, with no new class of antibiotics developed in fifty years. To tackle this crisis, researchers at the University of Pennsylvania are using advanced artificial intelligence tools to accelerate the discovery of new antimicrobial (抗菌的；抗微生物的。) molecules. The team views biology as an information system, training deep-learning models to scan millions of genetic sequences from living and extinct organisms. By using ChatGPT and Codex, the cross-disciplinary (跨学科的；交叉领域的。) laboratory bridges the gap between biology and computer science, allowing scientists to write software, analyze vast genomic (基因组的；基因组学的。) datasets, and explore new hypotheses (假设；假说。) in hours instead of years. However, lead researcher César de la Fuente emphasizes that computational screening (筛选；筛查。) is only the first step. Rigorous laboratory testing is still required to confirm that these candidate molecules can safely and effectively kill dangerous microbes without harming human cells.
研究团队利用 ChatGPT 与 Codex 加速筛选抗生素分子。耐药性病菌感染正在对全球医疗卫生构成紧迫威胁，而人类在过去五十年中几乎没有研发出全新类别的抗生素。为了应对这一危机，宾夕法尼亚大学的研究人员正在借助先进的人工智能工具加速寻找新型抗菌分子。该团队将生物学视为一个信息系统，训练深度学习模型在现存及已灭绝生物的数百万个基因序列中进行高效扫描。通过使用 ChatGPT 和 Codex，这个跨学科实验室打通了生物学与计算机科学之间的壁垒，使科学家们能够在短短数小时内完成程序编写、海量基因组数据分析以及科学假设探讨，而过去这些工作通常需要耗费数年。然而，项目带头人塞萨尔·德拉富恩特强调，计算机筛选仅仅是第一步，后续仍需通过严格的实验室测试，以确保这些候选分子能在不伤害人体细胞的前提下安全有效地杀灭危险病菌。（来源：OpenAI News）

[01:39] Tesla Schedules Roadster Unveiling as Musk Teases Extreme Performance. Tesla has officially announced that it will unveil the next-generation Roadster on October 1 in Texas, ending nearly a decade of anticipation (期盼；预先期待。) for reservation holders. CEO Elon Musk has actively hyped the presentation, claiming the electric supercar features extraordinary (非凡的；卓越的。) engineering that combines sports car performance with aerospace (航空航天的；航天技术的。) technology. The vehicle is designed to achieve zero-to-sixty acceleration in just 1.1 seconds and may include specialized rocket thruster (推进器；推力器。) options. While Tesla previously postponed (延期；推迟。) the project to focus on mass-market vehicles and autonomous driving software, customer interest remains high. The upcoming event will provide crucial details regarding final specifications (规格；技术参数。), production schedules, and delivery timelines for the ambitious vehicle.
特斯拉定档 10 月发布全新超跑 Roadster，马斯克预热极致性能。特斯拉已正式宣布将于 10 月 1 日在德克萨斯州揭开全新一代 Roadster 超跑的面纱，为等待已久的预订车主结束了长达数年的期盼。首席执行官埃隆·马斯克近期对发布会进行了高调预热，宣称这款纯电动超跑融合了跑车性能与航天科技的非凡工程设计。该车旨在实现 1.1 秒内完成百公里加速，并可能提供专属的火箭推进器选装配置。尽管特斯拉此前为了专注于大众量产车型与自动驾驶软件开发而推迟了该项目，但市场对其关注度依然居高不下。即将到来的发布会将正式揭晓这款备受瞩目的车型在最终规格、量产安排及交付时间表等方面的关键细节。（来源：Teslarati）

[02:28] NASA Invites Public to Celebrate International Observe the Moon Night. NASA is hosting its annual International Observe the Moon Night this Saturday, offering a unique opportunity for people of all ages to engage with lunar science. Following the historic Artemis II mission that carried four astronauts (宇航员；航天员。) around the Moon, this year's celebration highlights major milestones in deep space exploration. The main public event at NASA's Goddard Space Flight Center in Maryland will feature interactive science exhibits (展品；展览项目。), telescope observations, and a display of authentic (真实的；原装正品的。) Moon rocks collected during the Apollo 14 mission. The international event invites people worldwide to observe the Moon and explore our deep connection to Earth's nearest celestial (天体的；天空的) (天体的；天空的。) neighbor. Through in-person events and global virtual broadcasts (广播；网络直播。), NASA hopes to inspire public curiosity and celebrate ongoing robotic (机器人的；自动化探测的。) and human journeys into our solar system.
NASA 邀请全球公众参与国际观月之夜科普活动。NASA 将于本周六举办一年一度的“国际观月之夜”活动，为各年龄段的公众提供一个近距离感受月球科学魅力的绝佳机会。紧随搭载四名航天员完成绕月飞行的阿尔忒弥斯 2 号历史性任务之后，今年的庆祝活动将重点展示深空探索领域的重大里程碑。在马里兰州 NASA 戈达德太空飞行中心举行的主场活动中，公众将体验到互动科普展台、户外天文望远镜观测，并亲眼目睹阿波罗 14 号任务采集的真实月岩标本。这一国际性活动邀请全球民众共同观测月球，探索人类与地球最近天体邻居之间的深厚联系。通过线下活动与全球线上直播，NASA 希望激发公众对宇宙的好奇心，并致敬正在推进的无人探测与载人深空探索事业。（来源：NASA News）
